job.job_description:
Job Summary:

We are looking for a highly skilled Python Engineer with strong experience in Backend Development, GenAI, and Full Stack Engineering to build scalable AI-powered applications and intelligent automation platforms. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in Python, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and modern AI/LLM frameworks.

You will work on designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-grade AI solutions including LLM applications, agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, automation systems, and AI-integrated web platforms.

Responsibilities:

Design and develop scalable backend systems using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django.

Build and integrate GenAI/LLM-based applications using frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar.

Develop REST APIs, microservices, and AI orchestration pipelines.

Create end-to-end AI solutions including:

Prompt engineering

RAG pipelines

Vector database integrations

Multi-agent workflows

AI copilots/chatbots

Work on frontend integration using React.js, Next.js, HTML/CSS, or JavaScript frameworks.

Develop scalable data pipelines and AI model integration workflows.

Deploy and manage applications on cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP.

Collaborate with Product, Data Science, DevOps, and Engineering teams for AI product delivery.

Optimize AI application performance, scalability, security, and observability.

Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and production support.

Core Technical Skills

Strong programming expertise in Python

Experience with FastAPI / Flask / Django

Strong understanding of REST APIs & Microservices

Knowledge of SQL & NoSQL databases

Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, Docker, and Kubernetes

GenAI / AI Skills

Hands-on experience with:

OpenAI APIs

LangChain / LlamaIndex

RAG Architecture

Vector Databases (Pinecone, FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate)

Prompt Engineering

AI Agents / Agentic Workflows

LLM evaluation & monitoring

Exposure to NLP / ML concepts preferred

Full Stack Skills

Frontend experience with Angular / React.js / Next.js / JavaScript

Understanding of UI integration with AI applications

Experience building dashboards or AI web platforms

Cloud & DevOps

Azure / AWS experience

Containerization using Docker

CI/CD and deployment automation

Monitoring & logging tools exposure




Preferred Qualifications:

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.

Hands-on work experience with: Python, Django/Flask, AWS, Azure, Docker,Microservices.

TensorFlow / PyTorch exposure

Knowledge of GraphRAG or Knowledge Graphs

Experience with AI copilots and enterprise AI automation

Familiarity with MCP, AI orchestration, or autonomous agents

Experience in scalable SaaS product development




Key traits: 

Should have excellent communication skills.

Should be self motivated and willing to work as part of a team.

Should be able to collaborate and coordinate in a remote environment.

Be a problem solver and be proactive to solve the challenges that come his way.
